mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates for future corporate earnings and increasing equity valuations, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances despite a declining FEDFUNDS trend, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate above 7.5% over a 3-month window signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which increases the likelihood of central bank intervention and reduces inflation expectations, leading to lower real yields and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 7.5%, or the Rank IC over any 2-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both residential construction (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) signals weakening aggregate demand, which triggers a policy response from the Federal Reserve and reduces long-term real interest rates, boosting equity valuations and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the interaction effect (joint IC) is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in industrial production (INDPRO) below 99.0 for two consecutive months indicates a contraction in real output, which increases the probability of a recession and triggers risk-off behavior, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 99.0, or the Rank IC over any 2-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in consumer spending (RSAFS) combined with rising housing starts (HOUST) signals strong aggregate demand, which raises inflation expectations and prompts the Federal Reserve to maintain or tighten monetary policy, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when both RSAFS and HOUST rise, or the interaction effect (joint IC) is not significant (p > 0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid increase in non-farm payroll growth (PAYEMS) above 200k per month for two consecutive months signals labor market overheating, which increases wage pressures and inflation expectations, leading the Fed to delay rate cuts or initiate tightening, reducing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS > 200.0, or the Rank IC over any 2-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the CPIAUCSL above 2.5% year-over-year, combined with a stable or rising FEDFUNDS rate, signals persistent inflationary pressures, which increases the likelihood of a rate hike or delayed easing, raising discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 2.5% and FEDFUNDS is stable or rising, or the interaction effect (joint IC) is not significant (p > 0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP growth (GDPC1) below 2.0% annualized for two consecutive quarters signals a weakening economy, which increases the probability of fiscal or monetary stimulus, boosting equity valuations and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when GDPC1 < 2.0%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
